utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll keep the list by the door, and we can check in later about anything that comes up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll swing by later and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the porch light and a loose fence board.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll put you down for those.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, I think so, but I’m still trying to figure out the timing and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, just checking — so it’s happening, but the details aren’t locked in yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help out, though I may need a reminder on the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we’re collecting tools, screws, and any spare wood or wire folks can part with. I’ll remind you of the drop-off time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, thanks. I can bring by some screws and maybe a bit of spare wire—just remind me when to come over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs repairing, and where the drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s the usual stuff, maybe a few broken things folks dropped off. And the drive is over by the community center, I believe.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll double-check the exact items and head to the community center. Thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great timing — we still need a few hands for sorting donations, loading the van, and checking in people at the hall. If you can take one of those, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take sorting donations — just point me to the pile and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and hand me anything that’s missing? I’ve got a box of spares if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—I’ll sort the donated tools and flag anything missing. If I spot gaps, I’ll grab what we need from the spare box.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that would be really helpful. Just let me know the location and timing when you hear more.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep watching for the location and timing and tell you as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is still on for Saturday, and folks are bringing tools and spare parts by the community hall. If you need anything fixed, now’s the time to get it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know to bring what they can. I’ll swing by the hall and see if anyone still needs to add a fix to the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who still needs to add something and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going—do you still need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could still use a hand sorting the donated tools, if you’re free. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can help sort the donated tools. Where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I appreciate that, Nell — I’ll let everyone know the details and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Uli — I’m lining up the repair drive details now. If you can help spread the word, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rosa. I can share it with a few neighbors and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a big help, Uli — thank you. I’ll send you the details as soon as they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely—people have really been pitching in. If you want, I can pass along the latest details once I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Please let me know the latest details, and I’ll plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m just waiting on the final parts list, then I’ll send the repair-drive plan around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — send it my way when you have it, and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. A few sturdy tools and maybe some spare screws would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll bring some sturdy tools and a handful of spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring a flashlight and some extra batteries? I’ll keep track of the bins and set everything out by the curb.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring a flashlight and extra batteries.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word and connect folks who can pitch in on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you share the repair drive details with me first, so I can make sure I’ve got everything right before I pass it along?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — send me the details and I’ll make sure we’ve got them straight before I share them around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not much yet — I’m still gathering the broken items people want fixed. Once I have the list, I’ll share the details and timing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for the list. Thanks for gathering everything, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good cause, Gus—what kind of repairs are you collecting for?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly small home fixes—leaky faucets, loose hinges, broken lamps, that sort of thing. If you’ve got a job in mind, I can probably help find the right tool.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s handy — I was thinking of my front gate, it’s been squeaking something awful. If you know the right tool for that, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive — what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you handle the tool pickup and drop-off list? I’ll sort the volunteer sign-up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll make the tool pickup and drop-off list and keep it organized for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the logistics—when and where do we need to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s do the drop-off at the community center on Saturday morning. I’ll check the exact time and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Please send the exact time when you have it so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive today—want me to put you down for a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, put me down for a spot. I can bring some supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s awesome, Cleo—thanks! I’ll put you on the list and make sure folks know you’re bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times—what’s the repair drive looking like, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks, Faye. I’m still piecing it together, but I think we’ll need folks there after school pickup, and I’ll let you know the exact time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—just send the time once it’s set, and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you brought up the repair drive, Nell. Let’s make a simple list of the biggest fixes we want to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good, Rosa — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so a simple list would really help. What do you think we should put at the top?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d start with the broken porch steps, the streetlight near Maple, and the leaky roof at the community hall. Then we can check which ones need the most urgent help first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and check in if we need anything moved.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll stay on top of the location and flag any updates right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing something for the repair drive — what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, thanks for asking — we’re mostly looking for hands with sorting donations and a few folks who can help with simple fixes. I can put your name down if you’d like!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, put me down for sorting donations — I’m better with updates than the fixes, but I can help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. Mostly tools, nails, and a few hands to sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of those and check what’s on hand. If you can send me the list, I’ll help sort what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm happy to help out. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’m checking the list first so I don’t miss anything. I’ll tell you the remaining tasks in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—just let me know what’s left, and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it starts Saturday morning, but I’m a little fuzzy on the exact time. I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll plan around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’d appreciate that — I’m keeping it simple and trying not to make a fuss.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No fuss at all — I’ll bring a few useful tools and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—anything you need me to keep an eye out for while I’m out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—could you keep an eye out for a used cordless drill and any spare light bulbs?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll keep an eye out for a used cordless drill and some spare light bulbs. If I spot anything good, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I like a clear plan. Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll make a quick list of what needs fixing and bring it by, then we can split it up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — bring the list by, and we’ll go through it one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam—could you help sort donated tools and hand them out on Saturday? It’d make a huge difference.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and help hand them out on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — it’s going well so far. We could still use a few more hands if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m free — where do you want me to start?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs sorting?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Mara — I just need help sorting the donations and maybe labeling a few boxes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do that — I’ll help sort the donations and label the boxes. When should I come by?
